name: Consorcio Alfa de Administracao S.A.
summary: Consórcio Alfa de Administração S.A., through its subsidiaries, provides financing, insurance, and technology and services in Brazil. It operates through Retail, Insurance and Pension, and Services segments. The company was formerly known as Consórcio Real Brasileiro de Administração S.A. and changed its name to Consórcio Alfa de Administração S.A. in 1999. The company was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil. Consorcio Alfa de Administração S.A. is a subsidiary of Administradora Fortaleza Ltda.
